name: booth-desk
description: Offline manuscript proofing and ACX preparation for human audiobook recordings.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:core: esbuild src/core/acx/master.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/master.cjs && esbuild src/core/acx/export.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/export.cjs && esbuild src/core/manuscript/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/manuscript.cjs && esbuild src/core/glossary/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/glossary.cjs && esbuild src/core/sharing/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/sharing.cjs && esbuild src/core/markers/export.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/markers.cjs && esbuild src/core/proof/report.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/proof-report.cjs && esbuild src/core/proof/packet.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/proof-packet.cjs && esbuild src/core/proof/silence.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/proof-silence.cjs && esbuild src/core/duet/seats.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/duet-seats.cjs && esbuild src/core/audio/wav.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/audio.cjs && esbuild src/core/audio/splice.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/splice.cjs && esbuild src/core/acx/room.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/room.cjs && esbuild src/core/duet/mix.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/duet-mix.cjs && esbuild src/core/duet/timeline.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/duet-timeline.cjs && esbuild src/core/project/project.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-core/project.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run build:core && npm run verify:acx && npm run verify:delivery && npm run verify:restoration && npm run verify:loudness && npm run verify:markers && npm run verify:packet && npm run verify:collab && npm run verify:proof && npm run verify:book
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:model && npm run build && npm run audit:runtime && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:model && npm run build && npm run audit:runtime && electron-builder --win --publish never

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kosmos listens to the microphone to follow the page, check the room, and record a take. Audio stays on this computer.
